rationale: The expression matches the hypothesis (long cheap firms with positive lifetime earnings, short equally cheap deficit firms) and the sign gate gives a fully populated two-sided spread, but it sits uncomfortably close to the published retained-earnings decomposition of book-to-market (Ball–Gerakos–Linnainmaa–Nikolaev), so it is a coarser re-expression of a documented result rather than a wholly new mechanism.

The hypothesis claims a "cash-verified" tax validation but `txt` is book total tax expense including deferred taxes, so the gate does not measure cash remittance and its sign flips on accounting items (valuation allowances, deferred reversals) unrelated to distress, and the negative-tax subsample is small enough that the short leg will be thin and unstable.

Because both legs share the identical market-value denominator, the rank difference largely cancels the price scaling and collapses to a monotone ranking of ceq versus lt — i.e. inverse book leverage — so it does not isolate "residual cheapness" as claimed and instead re-tests the well-known leverage/distress-risk sort.

This is the archived gen-0 "Weakest-Link Cheap And Solvent" signal with IND_RANK swapped for RANK and `che` dropped from the buffer — a cosmetic re-parameterization of an already-evaluated construct rather than a substantively different mechanism, and the coverage argument does not change the fact that the same MIN-of-ranks hypothesis is being retested.

(act − lt)/market cap is Graham's net-current-asset-value ("net-net") screen, a long-documented value criterion, and it is a single-ratio value measure highly collinear with B/M rather than a genuine cross-theme interaction, though it is at least internally consistent and would have broad coverage.

The construction is internally coherent — the centered deleveraging z-score sets the sign and cheapness scales the magnitude, giving a two-sided spread that matches the stated "direction of travel" story — but the leverage-change leg overlaps materially with the established net debt issuance / external financing anomaly, so the incremental content rests entirely on the interaction with value.
